git diff --src-prefix="$(printf "'")" > out.patch
git diff --src-prefix="$(printf "'")" | wc -l
git diff --src-prefix=$'it\'s/' > out.patch
echo $"x" > out.txt
echo `date` > out.txt
git diff $(git merge-base HEAD main) > out.patch
diff <(git show HEAD:a) b
git diff >(tee out.patch)
echo 'unterminated > out.txt
git diff --src-prefix=$'it\'s/' | wc -l
echo $"x" | wc -c
echo `date` | wc -c
git diff $(git merge-base HEAD main) | wc -l
diff <(git show HEAD:a) b | wc -l
git diff >(tee out.patch) | wc -l
echo 'unterminated | wc -c
git diff 1<&2 | wc -l
